name: Grilled chicken at the camp
summary: VietNamNet names gà nướng in the summit-camp supper, with xôi đồ, rượu ngô, and rượu chuối. It does not say this is gà đồi. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: VietNamNet, Lê Dương, 16 Nov 2025, quoting the two-day trek plan.
howToEat: With the camp supper after the summit arrival that article prints at about 15:30. A recipe was not printed.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: The summit camp on that trek, from bản Pù Luông toward bản Báng. Not a shop.
seoTitle: Grilled chicken at the Pu Luong summit camp
seoDescription: Gà nướng is the summit-camp chicken on the 16 Nov 2025 VietNamNet plan, with xôi đồ and two wines. It is not called gà đồi. The price is Check on arrival.
